reviews.text: Review AI “coach”. The AI coach constantly ignored topics I was uncomfortable “discussing” even after I asked it not to “bring it up” anymore. And price of subscription doubled
Used it daily since 2019. Changed my life. Highly recommend.
I’m not buying your damn premium. .
Scam. Scam

Terrible. Don't bother unless you want to go through answering a bunch of questions on your well-being, only to be hit with a paywall you can't get by to even try out the app to see it if it'll work for you. At a minimum you'd have to pay $16.99 for one month, no trial no limited version no one week try free nothing like that. Hey Remente here's my middle finger.
Is it a joke?. I can’t access the app until I subscribe. The close button on the paywall does not work.

No app w/o a subscription…. There’s no way to go beyond the “Limited Time Offer” subscription AFTER creating a login. So no free trial to see if it’s even worth A) your TIME & B) your MONEY. The way the economy is now, the inflation, bloated ads/apps & cost of living, why should WE pay YOU as a developer & “self help app” OUR hard earned money when we have priorities, bills, household, & for some, families that come before an app? Do we not deserve an introductory period to see if it’s even what we want or need? Apps like this KILL the market. iOS and others following the subscription-based model are a bunch of thieves. At least majority of the developers have common decency & allow some sort of “free” version or trial.
👍. Very helpful for sorting out feelings and aspects of your life to work on. I love the care wheel! Then you can choose helpful tips on ways to improve weak points

Amazing!. I have been using this app for a little over three months now. It is absolutely incredible. I use the journal part all the time. I use voice to text so my journal entries are very detailed. I then copy those journal entries into the Coach part of the app. This allows the app to give me some really great feedback and advice on living a good life and making good decisions. When I am in a tough situation, it also helps going to the Coach and typing in my problem and it gives me really good advice.

Useless app. The app store is so bloated with useless junk and Remente is a perfect example of something nobody needs, nobody asked for, and nobody wants. It literally does absolutely nothing. You do not need this app. Do not waste your money on this junk.

Looks like a great app but impossible at the moment to use on an iPad. The various screens like “Hello” again are so far off the left of a the screen that you can on read half. And then when it ask how was your day there is a big blue face - I presume there is a rating system under the big blue face but it is off the screen and impossible to progress. Looks like it works fine on an iPhone but I want to actually type detailed things and use a keyboard with the iPad. If you can fix the screen formatting on the iPad version I will definitely use the app and increase my rating.
I can’t even use it. It wouldn’t even allow me to get past the intro like what am I supposed to do I wait but theirs no button or x

Used to be better. I think what the app can offer is amazing but it’s the accessibility to those things that make it difficult to like. I understand that they have to make their money but I just wish there were more options for people who can’t afford the premium resources.
Stopped working. Stopped working out of nowhere one day won’t even open up uninstalled l and reinstalled it still doesn’t open just crashes

super good. this app is exactly what i was looking for it gives you a notes part to write things you want to. which helps a lot more than having to write them on a separate app ,and it gives you lists of goals and even gives you a checklist of what to do. which helps ALOTT for me bc i have to organize everything to get things done and i’ve never thought about making checklist for ways to reach my goals.

Pricing.. I don't like that the app only offers a one-week trial period which is not enough time to explore and evaluate all of the features.

After 7 days, it also wants $59.99 per year up front and does not offer a monthly payment option.

I will be exploring competetors that offer flexible pricing.

Awesome app for young adults for average and high achievers. I have used Remente for 9 months and found it extremely helpful for goal-setting and life balance. I used a similar app like this known as the Life-Work Wheel. I didn't care for the features and the development of the app wasn't marketing towards the right subscribers. The developer of Remente had put a lot of thought and care for people who seek to learn and grow. 

For anyone seeking a goal-setting and Life Wheel I recommend this app

Really good, could be great. I have really been enjoying this app, but with just a couple of small changes, it could be even better. 

I love the layout, and how it’s so easy to navigate between the goals page, journal, and resources. I especially like how in-depth the goals section is and how you can add a checklist within a goal, track progress, etc. The resources are a really nice touch as well, and I especially enjoy the goal setting ones. I also love the quick daily sessions in the AM and PM.

My only issue is that I wish you could change your settings in the app. For example, the time you receive the daily session prompts is set when you sign up, but there doesn’t seem to be any way to change that, either within the app or the website (this is not something that is managed through Notifications, as I checked there). There needs to be a settings section in the app to manage things like this easily.
Journal problem. Every time I click on the Journal , the app crashes. I certainly don’t want to pay for this app if one of its key features doesn’t work. Do you have any suggestions?

Experienced a but. I really like this app, but there was a but where after the introductory video, the app would freeze on the life wheel page. Please fix this in a future update. Also is there something I could do to fix this myself?
Wow!!. OMGosh. Finally found the perfect app that I will use almost every single day without having the thought of losing money on my mind. So excited to continue this great app!!

Can’t see month at a glance. App is great! But I can’t see my calendar in full view. I would love to also be able to look at my month at a glance. If this was in place I would probably upgrade to premium. Please fix this ! 
But love the mental health check ins, the ability to journal, I can add notes to my goals and set a checklist on goals. It’s an amazing app !

Good app but shares data with “business partners”. Good app, good design. Unfortunately it shares your user data with third parties unlike other journaling apps. Probably isn’t a huge issue but I just find myself unable to speak freely in my journals knowing that the info isn’t wholly owned by me, or that it might be sold off to another company in the future.
This app is great. There’s no problems or adds which is nice you shouldn’t have any problems with it at all
Wouldn’t even open. Download this app really excited and it wouldn’t even open. It kept crashing. I don’t have the patience for that

Pretty great.. I like the app. I’m sad that I can only have up to three goals unless I pay, but it’s better then the rest of these kinds of apps. It’s definitely the favorite out of all the ones I tried out. But, I have OCD (and I’m sure a lot of others who have this app do too), and I need more organization. Here are some suggestions to make the app higher quality:

1. This one is really specific and easy to deal with. I don’t know if it’s a big, but when you tap on a step and then it takes you to another check off list you can check off the entire step at the top (the little circle next to the step name). When you tap it, the step checks off but it doesn’t show you that it checks off. In other words, it doesn’t appear blue like it does on the main page. I think it’s a bug, because it’s really annoying and I keep forgetting if I checked it off or not. Overall, i think the check off button for steps should turn blue when you are looking at the step info. 

2. Steps get cleared daily, or whatever you set them too, but you should be able to clear the check off lists within the steps. This is very annoying because I have a lot of check off boxes on some of my steps and when I check them all off I have to in-check them all the next day. So basically, it would make the app present itself better and look better overall if these check off lists got cleared daily with the step that they are in.

3. It crashes once in a while when you are editing goals. This definitely needs to be fixed.

4. When you are editing the steps and the checklist within a step, you can drag each one beneath or on top of another goal to organize yourself. (I like that. I think there should be more small things like that that help you organize yourself better). Anyway, when you drag a step or checklist item, sometimes it disappears if you don’t drag it fast enough. It leaves an empty space where it was and you have to restart the app and recreate the step/checklist. 

Thank you! I enjoy you app.
Doesn’t Recognize My Premium Payment. I paid for premium account and it refuses to give me access. Tried everything to reset. Can’t find a good contact to get help.

App crashes anytime I try to visit steps in the goals. So this app seems great but it crashes any time I try to tap on the steps for any goal I’m working on such as cutting sugar (for example). I’ve tried it both on iPad and the iPhone and both have the same result. Rather frustrating since I paid for a month. I’ve emailed support about it and if I don’t hear back I’ll delete the app and move on to something else. It’s a shame because, as I said, it seems great but if i can’t use it then what’s the point of having it?

A message to the developers:. Please correct the glitchiness! It freezes so often and doesn’t respond. Very frustrating. I know $4.99 for one month isn’t a lot of money, but a lot of my free apps function better. Likewise I suggest running spellcheck on articles before publishing as it feels amateurish and unprofessional reading all of this self-improvement information and stumbling upon typos and misspelled words. 

The pros are the concepts and it’s also pretty.

Update removed some features?. I remember you use to be able to write descriptions and schedule out goals and have goals repeat daily. Those options seem to have disappeared after this new update? I like the app, but not being able to have repeat goals daily easily makes things frustrating for me. Please explain how to do this or bring that functioning back!

Underwhelming. I paid for a quarterly subscription because I wanted the premium features (no trial period for this app). I’m bummed I bothered paying for it, there isn’t any difference from the free version as far as I can tell except that you can add more goals. I did the motivation goal and it gave me actions like “create a SMART plan” but doesn’t go into detail into how to really set up a plan or be held accountable for it. I had to google to get an idea on how to start. I’m not sure what the Insights tab is for because it didn’t analyze anything about me. Even the life wheel just showed me visually how I’m feeling in the moment about certain aspects of my life. But there weren’t any tips or suggestions based on that data.

I signed up for Fabulous and I feel like that app delivered what I expected from Remente as far as resources, alerts, detailed letters to motivate me, a calendar view of how many times I’ve consistently kept up with a goal, etc.

Perfect for keeping you on track. After cycling through many of these apps throughout 2019 I can confidently say that Remente gave me the most success. It kept me in line and made sure that I didn’t forget about it. Unlike a lot of the others, Remente excels in all areas that it wishes to. From keeping you on a set schedule all the way to tracking your mood, there is a lot of value you can take out of the app. One of my favorites about this app is that it doesn’t overload you with notifications as well, whatever you set is what you get. As for setting goals, Remente has a great layout. They offer their own Goal Plans as well as allow you to create your own very detailed plans for the future. After so many failed attempts on other apps, I wasn’t very optimistic going into Remente but luckily I was quickly enjoying it.

Their emails never ever stop!!!. This app was deleted from my phone weeks ago. Then suddenly three days ago I started receiving emails from this app. The unsubscribe link does NOT WORK. In the last three days I have received EIGHT emails!! If this app truly cared about those with PTS they would not be using spam to get their message out. If you don't want to be stalked by an app with no recourse, DO NOT download!!

Almost awesome. As an iPad Pro user for all things, the lack of being able to have the screen flip is almost a non-starter (unfortunately). But if everything else worked like a charm, maybe I would use it. I only used the free version and I personally don’t mind what some other reviewers complained about with the free version. The price point for the Premium seems reasonable for a coaching app if it is completely dialed in and the content feels valuable. 

Here is what I loved about the app. The interface is simple and fun to use. The wheel of happiness is really cool and the way you can scroll the timeline and see a time-lapse display of how you feel about any one sector is helpful and interesting. The journaling is nice and setting up my day was fun and easy.

Why I lost my positive mojo? I decided to edit my goal. There is no button that lets you edit a goal, but there were the ... in the upper right hand corner I press them and the program terminates and I’m out. I try it 3 more times, same thing. Maybe it is a simple bug or whatever, but setting up a program like this (especially if you invest in the Premium version) takes lots of time and I just don’t want to invest my time on a program that is buggy from the get go. I may try it again some day because it has potential if the courses are good, the bugs gone and horizontal workspace available.

good stuff. this is one of the best mental health apps i have found so far, personally. The others are usually so limited and you can only really benefit if you pay a fee. But this app is a very easy to use app to help you just refocus and reflect. It’s exactly what I needed right now. And the gentle reminders really do help. love it!

Definitely Cute UX Design. Content and Function?. This app is so cute it makes you want to buy it right away! There are lots of great topics on the app for personal growth. 

Dig in a little deeper, however, and you’ll find that there’s not really anything special about it. It has general information. The “Goal Plans” are basic lists of information. For anyone who needs guidance in achieving the goals, you won’t find it here, no detailed insight provided. “Boosts” are tips - about a paragraph of reading content that lacks significance and relevance. “Courses” are no more professional or in-depth than you would find in a blog written by an average person. There are articles within the materials from “experts.” The “Master Communicator” course, for example, doesn’t even touch on the foundation that our communication is built on. It doesn’t discuss self-talk, positive voice, self-esteem...okay. 

Like many other people have said, you must pay up! The free version won’t keep you around long! It’s so cute, and the topics are great. There’s something mysterious about what you’re going to get if you upgrade. Will it suddenly be fabulous? Read the description of the benefits of going premium and you’ll be far from excited. 

Very cute! Great ideas! Consider analyzing some other apps for the structure and organization. Improve the content. Nice dashboard as far as I can tell. 

Lastly, offer a free trial. Anyone who believes in their product has no issue doing so.
I can’t read the article to the end. Why every article cut off in the middle. I am a premium user.

Great for the goal getter. Let me start by stating - I am usually one who uses a physical planner. In fact, I’ve tried almost every “productivity” and “personal development” planner out there. Some examples are the panda planner, the law of attraction planner, best self planner, and I even made my own custom planner with plum paper. HOWEVER, I was getting tired of lugging it around with me, and my iPhone calendar just wasn’t going to record the day to day data I was looking to keep track of. HELLO REMENTE. I was skeptical at first, I won’t lie, but I jumped in with both feet and purchased the premium version. I’ve been using this for 3 or 4 weeks now and I’m in love. It captures my mood, my productivity, and pulls data from other apps to track my sleep & my steps. My only wish is that is would give me the option to color code my to do list, since I have responsibilities in so many areas of life that I would normally color code in my physical planner. Another great feature would be having the ability to make repeat to-do’s. Other than that though, I am soooo happy with this app and I think EVERYONE should try it!

So far so good.. It’s say two with the app. I have downloaded and tired many apps like this. So far this is my favorite.
Will update later on.

Not for me. Well it’s ok for me. The journey keeps messing up so it’s hardly useful. Tried contacting support but they never got back to me with a fix. I did try goal wizard which I really like. 

For me I just don’t feel like the app is gelling me accomplish my goals. So for now I think I’ll give it a break.

Fantastic concept and execution. This is a wonderful, healthy, and helpful idea for an app. I’m truly glad I found this. I have been journaling as I’m going through a breakup and this app gives me an easier, more at-my-fingertips way of jotting down my experiences and feelings without having to agree to anything or pay for anything. Highly recommend!!! I’m excited to see the positive effects it has in the future as well.
Love it but just needs a little adjustment. Great program i just wish that it integrates with my calendar for the purpose of time blocking
Sometimes. I don’t always feel like writing but it’s nice to have it when I do
Great so far. I’ve been using it for a few days but this is what I have been looking for in a task and mood app. I can also reflect.
Helpful, without costing me anything.. This app helps with daily reminders. This app helps me reflect on my feelings. I’m definitely appreciating it.

Won’t let you add any goals in free version. Liked the app until it started refusing to let me add goals unless I upgraded to the premium plan. It gives me a message saying I can only have three goals in the free version. I currently have added 0 goals and it won’t let me add any unless I’m on premium, so I’ve just deleted the app. It’s impossible to use effectively without paying, so forget it. Don’t advertise a free platform and then refuse to let us use the free platform. Edit: I’ve now received a response from their help team saying they can’t replicate what I was dealing with and to reach out to them. I don’t feel encouraged to reach out to them based on that reply. I have no incentive to take the time out of my day to post a review if I am not actually dealing with the issue I described. If you can’t replicate the issue, I’m not encouraged the app is worth it or that a tech team could resolve the issues. I’ve already troubleshooted the app, logging out and back in, deleting and redownloading, all of which failed to resolve the issue.

I’m changing bad habits. So starting slow , the app tracks your happiness , you balance in life , and what you do. 

In order to keep this up you must do it everyday. 

Never skip a day. 

Look at the balance sheet to see what you may want to focus on, and just do it.

Almost impossible to reset password. I never sign in through any app or site with a social media site. But Remente seems determined that I do. I’m getting rid of hardly used social media sites now, one of the last to go is Facebook, which I only use as an electronic Rolodex for mainly people I really knew in high school decades ago. No, no one gets a free pass there Steal my information like every one else Remente.
Coolio kinda app. Helpful. Fun. It’s great, just don’t like that I’d have to buy premium to have more features, but overall it’s great.

Great App, hard to find a replacement. Two years ago I had an Android when I first downloaded this app. It was perfect and really helped me mentally get out of a difficult time in my life. I purchased the year subscription which was $23, a good price for what it offered. I switched to an iPhone and I have been looking for a similar app and just wasn’t happy with what I was finding. I was relieved when I found this app again but sad to see the year subscription increased so much or maybe that’s the price it has always been for iPhone users. 🤷‍♀️ Either way I will continue to use the free version until I find another app that can let me plan ahead at a cheaper price.

Great motivational app. I‘ve only been using this app for 2 weeks or so, but I absolutely love it. I paid for the subscription about 24 hours after I started trying it. The Resources section has tons of well assembled content, and the app is already helped tremendously in my efforts to become more organized and focused on my goals, as well as teaching me how to make better, more effective goals with tangible near future rewards.
Good but Need landscape mode. I'm really blocked from using this awesome app bc I can't use an iPad keyboard and have to use the screen keyboard to type. It's really the biggest blocker for me.
To Do List. I use the free version because I’m cheap even though the resources look valuable. I really use the Daily Task list to keep a running list of everything I have to do as a teacher.
I HATE THIS. I was recommended this app from my boyfriend/bother

Great app! Please add Iwatch compatibility. I love the app. It facilitates setting goals and adding steps towards your goals in your day plan. I can add certain things to be on my plan on certain days of the week automatically. Lots of functionality and resources. Only down fall i see is there is no Iwatch compatibility. This feature would be great. I would love to be able to mark tasks in my day plan completed from the watch.

Excellent but room for improvement.. I absolutely LOVE this app. The subscription is very pricey though so I’m on the fence about subscribing. What’s with all the subscriptions these days? Gone we’re the days when we could just buy the app and cut the cord. Now we gotta wear a leash🙄🤷🏻‍♀️. Commitment. Commitment. Commitment.

So why not 5 stars? Well I do own an iPhone and I’m a Apple product girl but when it comes to fitness, fitbit has my heart. With this in mind, remente has only partnered with Apple for fitness stats. Please add Fitbit so I’ll be able to sync my data and then I’ll consider that commitment you seek. 

The learning tools/ videos are a nice plus but not something I really see myself using. That sort of info can freely be found online, on YouTube or through any on Tony Robbins stuff.

I mainly need this app for setting my daily goals and would like to set them in advance..... maybe you guys can have a tiered membership plan. Like trial( as is) , basic( trial content plus ability to plan days in advance but no access to additional courses, videos etc) , premium ( access to everything)

Dang it🤭🤔.... I should’ve put this review on my to do list so I could’ve checked it off.😁😄

Thanks Remente. Great app. Please consider partnering with Fitbit and maybe a tiered membership.😊
Crashes. I’m trying to use it but it’s constantly crashing

What an amazing resource!. The free version gives you access to very helpful, well written, concise information. Premium gives you ways to track your goals and access to many many more courses and more. Thanks for making this.

Enjoying So Far. I really like this app. It’s help so far and I’m glad that they do have stuff unlocked that I can do. I’m really looking forward to buying the full version and seeing what it has to offer. 
I haven’t experience any issues with that app so that’s a plus as well.

Rip off. Like others have said, everything is behind a pay gate. The app was advertising a 50% off subscription rate which I went ahead and purchased. However, I still can’t access the paid features. Several days later, I still only have the free version and at every turn get prompts to upgrade to premium. I emailed Remente’s support team to resolve it and still no answer. On top of that, Apple won’t refund my purchase. Not worth the hassle.

Much more productive and happy balanced life. I love this app! It helps me take a look at my overall life so I can see where I need work. I love the articles, the task list, the mood check, the goal setting. Ive definitely been more productive and more conscious of my mood and activities that correspond to a good day and not so good day. Highly recommend!

Best app for motivation. I really enjoy this app because of all the goals, and motivation it has given me. It has taught me how to appreciate the world around me and my life. It also helped me improve my habits and I have become a way more happy, positive person because of this app! Highly recommend. It’s also free! I get so much for free! Many other apps only have 1 free course. But this app has many! I truly appreciate this! Please download! You won’t regret it!

Self-Improvement. This app has helped me so much already with my self-improvement. I know there are a lot of things I need to change within myself and how I see myself and this app helps you achieve that. I think I might honestly pay for the premium version because this app helps me so much

Spiritual Focus- The Next Step For This App. This app is incredible! There are so many helpful resources within this app as well as different ways to measure how you are feeling and what you are focusing on. I really love how it teaches you how to set proper goals so that you set yourself up for success!

I personally think it would be beneficial to add an optional spiritual focus, as well as spiritual resources and goals in the app that users can choose if they so desire. Obviously this is a very general topic so it would be difficult to pinpoint sources users could refer to that they would enjoy. But maybe the sources could be divided up by religion (Christianity, Jewish, Muslim, etc) and by general spirituality. 
This would require a lot of work, but I really think it would be the next step for this app moving forward. 
It would be ideal to eventually even divide up into specific religious groups so that those who seek sources for their spirituality can find sources from their faith (that is, if their church releases such articles online). 

As a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints, I personally feel it would benefit me a ton to include this aspect in the app. I love finding spiritual applications to the things I learn from Remente. I know I’m not the only one that feels this way too! :) 

Anywho, this app is amazing! I’m thoroughly enjoying it, and I look forward to continued updates in the future!

A personal assistant in an application and an absolute wonder !. This application is so helpful and easy to use. I don’t feel like I need a real personal assistant because this app does everything for me! It’s absolutely phenomenal!

Wonderful app!. This is my favorite mindfulness app. It can help keep you organized and mindful of your feelings, and whatnot. Help you set and achieve goals. I haven’t tried premium but the free stuff really is worth it.

Free version not helpful. Seems like a good concept, but the free version doesn’t do enough to be worth downloading. You enter info but then can’t see it the next day if you don’t become a premium subscriber. Get a notebook.

Don’t believe the hype.... After reading reviews, I was excited to dl this app and utilize its courses and features. I was so sold on its effectiveness that after discovering that most of its features aren’t available without a subscription, I went right ahead and paid for a full year. It’s all been down hill from there. I was extremely underwhelmed by the courses. Both in the variety, and quality. For example - As a single woman, I don’t need an app to tell me how to create an online dating profile. I mean really, that’s your big insight for single people interested in improving their love life?! Accepting that I wasn’t going to get any big insights from their lame course library, I was sure that the magic would happen in the goal setting section. Again I was disappointed. The functionality of this section offers nothing that I can’t already get by just entering reminders on my iPhone. And in fact, the free Reminders tool has waaaay more customizable features (with actual reminders that will pop up as often as you like). A little prompt pops up when you create a goal with tips on how to set SMART goals. Again, nothing revolutionary here. All info I could have received for free by googling ‘goal setting’. You get two prompts per day from Remente, you can select what time of day you get them and that’s it. How is that going to help keep you motivated?!!! Again, just by creating reminders or calendar invites I can do WAAAY more than sending myself two silly prompts in the morning and at night. They’re not even customizable in terms f messaging. I want something that’s going to give me that extra push at 3p, “You got this!” Or I might have times when I want 18 alerts to come up throughout the day. Offering two generic prompts seems like they’re catering to someone who already has too much noise in their life. So maybe this app just isn’t made for people like me. Idk, but I’m pretty irritated with myself that I forked over $50 for features I already have free and easy access to in other built in apps on my phone. If any of this resonates with you, DON’T WASTE YOUR MONEY. Chances are if you’re serious about achieving your goals, you’ve already got more than enough tools to support you. Don’t be lured in by the resource/course library either. There’s millions of free blogs that cover the same subjects in more depth. Just google whatever topic you want along with the words how to. Meh.
Get more done. Getting so much more done with this app! A great tool to organize and plan your goals, and master your week personally and professionally.
It’s crashes. Will shut down every single time I try and check something in my reminders
Immediate failure.. Facebook signup doesn’t work.

More effort. I’ve only had the app for a couple days but if I get the full potential out if the apps intentions By the end of 2019 I will be in a much better place. Im really engaged in trying to fully understand the app. Great Idea for a app.

Low quality content, lots of upsell.. Virtually everything is paygated. The content is organized into "courses" but these tend to be small collections of pithy blog articles, such as you probably get in your email every day or find yourself reading on Medium because you have lost track of time. Harmless fluff but not the sort of thing anyone should be paying for. Apart from this there isn't much here. The goal section is more content-farm blogspam. The app has a todo-list style planner, but even just making a short list for tomorrow is a "premium" feature. If you're using that word to describe a function that came free with my phone ten years ago, I don't think you know what it means.

Excellent life improvement app. This is an excellent app if you want to set goals and focus on improving your life. I’ve only had it for a week and it’s already helped me formulate and organize my goals and thoughts more so than I have ever done. Also has a clever journal function built-in which is very useful for jotting down notes and reflections. It also has great suggested courses to help you improve in various areas depending on where you rate yourself in the categories of your life.

I have a couple of suggestions below:

1) On the Goals page perhaps provide the ability to divide into short term, medium term, and long-term goals. Or maybe just have the ability to have some kind of labeling.

2) Allow more flexibility for task repeat function such as 2x per month or once a quarter, etc. instead of just by week.

3) On the iPad version please allow landscape mode since the new iPad Pro cover is not very portrait friendly.

Please keep up the fantastic work, thank you!

okay but. i really like the idea of this app but my main hope was having an app as a mental health journal and now i noticed you can’t go back to previous days or export your data for a professional without paying for premium, which is frustrating for someone who’s already struggling financially. i understand the developers have to make money, but highly disappointed that it isnt more easily accessible for people who really need it.

Makes you pay monthly for basic functionality. This app would be cool, but when you set a “goal”, it won’t let you look at the tasks in the goal a day ahead or behind without paying monthly. A Perfect Fit for a Picky Designer. I have tried A LOT of apps out there that are “suppose to” help with productivity and mental health. Yet, I found myself being fatigued by poor UI design, features that focused on fluff instead of just being practical, and others that were simply bad. I found Remente by accident, and safe to say I will be a user for life. 

SUMMARY
Smooth and fluid, with features that make sense, I find Remente very easy AND enjoyable to use (very important for a designer like me who can criticize just about anything in an app) 

SPECIFICS
The gentle reminders, the customizable plan goals you can make for yourself, the additional help in the form of bite sized courses, are all super helpful and have added value to my experience when handling my mental health. 

The main selling feature though, to me, is the fact that Remente can be a resource I hand off to my therapist. She can easily comb through the qualitative data (my “journaling” in the notes section) and quantitative data (the mood scale and “8 areas of interest” wheel). It’s another way for her to see what’s going on in my life outside of her office walls. This app allows me to share more of my raw emotions in the moment rather than me just recalling them days later. Very useful. 

15/10 would recommend ☺️👍

Almost the perfect life goal setting and tracking app. The interface: 
-by far one of the best. It's sleek, intuitive, and just simply looks good 

Practicality:
-the app sets up a perfect template of 8 goal categories, e.g. Health, family & friends, fun & recreation...areas applicable to anyone's life so it does the leg work of thinking for you. To add to this point, the app has some preset goals within each of those categories and a number of steps to achieve that goal. These are actually really good suggestions if you don't even know what your goals should be or the steps you should take to achieve them.
The great part is, you can add as many steps as you want, they can be defined for specific date, or frequency, so there's quite a bit of flexibility with these steps.

Customizability
-where this app gets four stars. 
. I had my own category definitions and actually had 10 for my life. The downside is, you can't edit the categories or add any.
Also, you can't see your overall progress of goals at a high level for each category. 
These are two functions I would ask Remente to add in a future build.
